{"unitId":"blue-1","x":1900,"y":1700,"facingDeg":55,"formation":"line","strength":595,"morale":80,"fatigue":14,"ammo":78,"status":"active","continuing":{"kind":"hold"},"orders":[],"account":"Col. Aubry has no new order and stays in line on the south bank. When the enemy column crosses the bridge and forms on his flank at about 150 m, he wheels his line to face it and gives it volleys by battalion, steadily, until it breaks and goes back over the bridge. He does not follow it."},
{"unitId":"blue-2","x":2120,"y":1655,"facingDeg":300,"formation":"line","strength":525,"morale":69,"fatigue":18,"ammo":80,"status":"active","continuing":{"kind":"hold"},"orders":[{"orderId":"b2-11","result":"carried-out"}],"account":"Col. Delacroix is told to advance at once to the south end of the bridge and close it. He does, but not at the double: he marches off in column, halts to deploy into line before he gets within reach of the bridge head, and by the time he is forward the enemy column is already over the bridge and forming on the south bank, 60 m from his flank. He deploys facing it and opens fire at close range, rather than charge. He closes the bridge once the column breaks and holds there.","departure":"Projection brings the 2nd Battalion into line by minute 4, which assumes a hasty advance. A cautious colonel who stops to form before closing is a couple of minutes later, so fire begins later and his losses are smaller (525 against 517), his morale higher and his position about 25 m off."},
{"unitId":"blue-3","x":1960,"y":1790,"facingDeg":0,"formation":"line","strength":200,"morale":85,"fatigue":3,"ammo":100,"status":"active","continuing":{"kind":"hold"},"orders":[{"orderId":"b3-11","result":"carried-out"}],"account":"Maj. Verneuil is told to hold in reserve behind the 1st Battalion and not to engage unless ordered. He moves up and forms close behind the 1st, as far forward as the order allows, and watches the enemy column come over the bridge and break. He is burning to charge, but his orders are plain: he stays in reserve and does not pursue.","departure":"Projection sends the squadron into the fight and then in pursuit as far as (2050,403), killing most of the column (137+205+34 men). The order says not to engage unless ordered, and none comes, so he holds in reserve behind the 1st Battalion, and the column's survivors are not ridden down."},
{"unitId":"red-1","x":2050,"y":1050,"facingDeg":0,"formation":"column","strength":400,"morale":5,"fatigue":50,"ammo":70,"status":"broken","continuing":{"kind":"move","x":2050,"y":400},"orders":[{"orderId":"r1-11","result":"carried-out"}],"account":"Col. Brandt, already on the bridge when his order comes, pushes straight over it at the double and forms on the south bank as ordered, in the face of a battalion in line 150 m on his flank and another coming up. He presses the attack hard and holds his ground for a quarter of an hour under fire from both, losing heavily and unable to get his men to advance. At about the fourteenth minute they break and run, back over the bridge.","departure":"Projection leaves the Vanguard with 149 men after the cavalry ride it down and sends it to (2029,300). With no pursuit, about 250 men are lost to volleys and the rout, 400 remain and it flees about 600 m north of the bridge. Strength and position both differ by more than the tolerance."},
{"unitId":"red-2","x":2250,"y":1250,"facingDeg":180,"formation":"line","strength":650,"morale":66,"fatigue":17,"ammo":100,"status":"active","continuing":{"kind":"hold"},"orders":[],"account":"Col. Hartmann has no order and waits on the north bank, by the book. He watches the Vanguard cross the bridge and be beaten, and does not move without orders. His men are shaken by the sight."},
{"unitId":"red-3","x":1550,"y":400,"facingDeg":180,"formation":"line","strength":220,"morale":85,"fatigue":0,"ammo":100,"status":"active","continuing":{"kind":"hold"},"orders":[],"account":"Maj. von Reiter has no order and holds his position."}

"summary":"Red-1, already on the bridge, pushed across and formed on the south bank, as ordered, with Blue-1 in line 150 m on its flank. Blue-1 fired on it with volleys, and Blue-2, advancing from its place behind the right, came up some minutes later than the projection supposed. A cautious colonel deployed before closing, then fired at under 100 m. From minute 6 or so the column took the fire of both battalions, losing about 250 men in all, and at about minute 14 it broke and fled back over the bridge. The cavalry, ordered to stay in reserve and not engage unless told, did not pursue, so the broken column escaped with about 400 men, about 600 m up the road. Blue-2 closed the bridge. Blue losses were about 5 men in the 1st Battalion and 25 in the 2nd. Red-2 held on the north bank and was shaken. Red-3 held."}
